faq.a: Yes. OFF42 is free and open source under the MIT license. There are no subscriptions, accounts or in-app purchases.
Core editing runs locally on your computer without uploading files. Optional online features need a connection; availability varies by platform.

faq.q: Can OFF42 open Microsoft Office files?
faq.a: Yes. DOCX, XLSX and PPTX open on Mac and Windows, and so do ODT, ODS and ODP. On Mac, DOC42 and XLS42 also open legacy DOC and XLS files. Not every Office feature is supported, so check complex files after import.
A preview DMG is available for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later.
Preview with all six apps. Extract the entire ZIP, then launch the app you want. Includes tools for labels and barcodes.

name.label: WHAT'S IN A NAME
name.title: OFF is for office. And for everything you can switch off.
name.officeText: Six apps for every file on your desk: PDFs, Word and Excel files, slides, photos and scans.
name.offlineText: Editing runs locally on your computer. No account or file uploads.
name.offText: No subscription, no trial period, no ads. MIT-licensed and free, today and tomorrow.
name.answerText: The answer to the ultimate question of life, the universe and everything. We simply applied it to the office.

marks.label: SIGNATURES AND STAMPS
marks.title: Sign and stamp like on paper. No printer, no scanner.
marks.text: Add images of your own signature and stamp to your document.
points: Signatures in ballpoint, gel, fountain or felt-tip ink
132 stamp styles: round seals, company stamps, “Paid” and “Received”
Learns your own signature from a few samples
Works in PDFs, documents, slides, spreadsheets, images and scans
marks.note: A drawn signature is not a certificate-based digital signature. When you need one, PDF42 signs with your certificate.
marks.signedCaption: A contract signed and stamped in PDF42. Names and companies are fictional.

codes.label: QR CODES, MARKS AND LABELS
codes.title: QR codes, CE marks and label sheets, to the millimetre.
codes.text: Turn a cell, a table row or a selection into a QR, Data Matrix, Code 128 or Aztec code, and add the conformity and safety marks your product needs. Set the size in millimetres, then print a whole sheet of labels straight from your rows.
points: QR, Data Matrix, Code 128 and Aztec codes that stay editable after saving
97 marks: CE, UKCA, EAC, FCC, UL, CCC, KC, RCM, WEEE, RoHS, GHS pictograms, IEC safety symbols and more
Label sheets from spreadsheet rows, document tables or a PDF page or region
559 label stocks or your own grid, saved templates and printer calibration
codes.note: A mark is artwork for your label: it does not certify the product. For conformity marks and trademarks the app shows the conditions of use, such as a required certificate or licence number. In PDF42, DOC42 and XLS42 on Mac and Windows.
codes.qrAlt: Insert Symbol or Code in XLS42: a 30 mm QR code made from a product link.
codes.labelsAlt: Create Labels in XLS42: a label sheet with QR codes built from ten product rows.
codes.caption: A label sheet made from ten spreadsheet rows. The products are fictional.

web.label: OFF42 IN THE BROWSER
web.title: Open, convert and create files right in your browser.
web.text: The web app runs the OFF42 engine compiled to WebAssembly. Files are processed inside the browser tab and offered back as downloads: nothing is uploaded and nothing is installed.
points: Preview DOCX, ODT, RTF, Markdown, HTML and text files and save them in another of these formats
View XLSX, ODS, XLS and CSV sheets with calculated values and save them as XLSX, ODS or CSV
Show PPTX and ODP slides as a text outline and convert between the two formats
Read a PDF's page count, metadata, bookmarks, attachments and form fields
Make QR, Data Matrix, Code 128 and Aztec codes, A4 label sheets as PDF, product marks, signatures and stamps
web.limits: It is a preview with clear limits: documents, spreadsheets and presentations cannot be exported to PDF, PDF pages are not displayed, slides are shown as text only, and stamps support Latin, Cyrillic and Greek script only. The engine is a one-time download of up to 16 MB. The desktop apps for Mac and Windows have the full feature set.

documents.title: Space for your next good idea
documents.seoTitle: Free Word Processor for Mac — DOCX, ODT, RTF | OFF42
documents.seoDescription: Write letters and reports in DOC42: open and save DOCX, ODT, RTF and Markdown, lay out pages with tables and images, export PDF. Free and open source.
documents.intro: Write letters, reports and the next draft with DOC42. Combine rich text and page layout with familiar document formats.
points: Open and save DOCX, ODT, RTF, Markdown and other text formats.
Work with formatting, tables, images and page layout.
Export to PDF when the document is ready to share.
steps: Create a document or open an existing file.
Shape the text, images and page layout.
Save an editable copy or export a PDF.
documents.note: Complex Office documents can render differently. Check imported layout and the exported file before relying on exact fidelity.
documents.question: Can I work with Word documents?
documents.answer: DOC42 supports DOCX and opens legacy DOC files. File-format support does not imply identical handling of every Microsoft Word feature.

spreadsheets.title: Make sense of the numbers
spreadsheets.seoTitle: Free Spreadsheet App for Mac — XLSX, ODS, CSV | OFF42
spreadsheets.seoDescription: Open XLSX and XLS files, use formulas, formatting and charts, save XLSX, ODS or CSV and export PDF with XLS42. A free, open-source spreadsheet app for Mac.
spreadsheets.intro: From a simple list to a calculated report, XLS42 brings cells, formulas and charts into your everyday office.
points: Open XLSX, legacy XLS, ODS and delimited text files.
Use formulas, formatting and charts to explain your data.
Save XLSX, ODS or CSV, or export a PDF.
steps: Open a workbook or start with a blank sheet.
Enter data, apply formulas and add a chart.
Review calculations and save in the right format.
spreadsheets.note: Formula and formatting support varies by file. CSV stores a single table of values, not a complete workbook with formatting and multiple sheets.
spreadsheets.question: Can I open Excel spreadsheets?
spreadsheets.answer: Yes, XLS42 opens XLSX and legacy XLS files. Check complex formulas and imported formatting; not every Excel feature is supported.

presentations.title: Give your ideas the floor
presentations.seoTitle: Free Presentation App for Mac — PPTX, ODP | OFF42
presentations.seoDescription: Build slides with text, images, shapes and tables, present with speaker notes and export PDF or images with PPT42. Free, open source, made for Mac.
presentations.intro: Build a clear visual story with PPT42. Arrange text, images, shapes and tables, then move from editing to a slide show.
points: Work with PPTX and OpenDocument presentation files.
Arrange slide objects, tables and speaker notes.
Export slides to PDF and images for easy sharing.
steps: Create a deck or open a supported presentation.
Refine each slide and prepare your notes.
Run a slide show or export your slides.
presentations.note: Legacy PPT files need conversion first. Complex imported layouts can differ; review the full deck before presenting.
presentations.question: Can I share slides as a PDF?
presentations.answer: Yes. PPT42 supports PDF export for slides and notes pages, as well as PNG and JPEG slide images.

edit-pdf.title: Edit PDFs on your Mac
edit-pdf.seoTitle: Free PDF Editor for Mac — Edit, Annotate, Fill Forms | OFF42
edit-pdf.seoDescription: Edit PDF text, highlight, annotate, fill forms and reorder pages on your Mac with PDF42. Free, open source and offline — no uploads to an online editor.
edit-pdf.intro: Make the PDF your working document. Edit page text, add notes, highlight the important parts, fill forms and put pages in the right order with PDF42.
points: Edit page text and annotate with highlights, text boxes, shapes and freehand marks.
Insert, extract, rotate, delete and reorder pages.
Fill supported PDF forms and save your changes.
steps: Open a PDF from your Mac.
Choose markup, forms or page tools for your task.
Save a copy and review the finished document.
edit-pdf.note: Page-text edits flatten on save. Complex PDF layouts and forms can vary; review a saved copy before sharing.
edit-pdf.question: Can I edit a PDF without uploading it?
edit-pdf.answer: Yes. PDF42 works with local files on your Mac. Core markup and page operations do not need an online editor.

scan-ocr.title: Turn paper into searchable work
scan-ocr.seoTitle: Scanner App with OCR for Mac — Searchable PDF | OFF42
scan-ocr.seoDescription: Scan from a scanner or iPhone camera, straighten and clean pages, recognise text on your Mac and export a searchable PDF with SCN42. Free and offline.
scan-ocr.intro: Bring paper into your digital office with SCN42. Acquire pages, straighten and clean them up, then recognise text on your Mac.
points: Acquire from supported scanners or import images and PDFs.
Crop, deskew and adjust pages before recognition.
Export searchable PDFs or recognised text.
steps: Scan or import your pages.
Check page order and clean up the images.
Run OCR and export the format you need.
scan-ocr.note: Scanner and Continuity support depends on your hardware. OCR languages and accuracy depend on Apple Vision and the source image; the 20 interface languages are a separate feature.
scan-ocr.question: Can I search the text in a scan?
scan-ocr.answer: Export a searchable PDF after OCR to add a text layer. Always review recognition results, particularly names, numbers and low-quality scans.

compress-pdf.title: Compress PDFs, keep things moving
compress-pdf.seoTitle: Compress PDF on Mac — Reduce File Size Offline | OFF42
compress-pdf.seoDescription: Shrink image-heavy PDFs on your Mac with PDF42. Choose 100, 150 or 220 dpi, preview the size and keep text sharp. Free, offline, no file uploads.
compress-pdf.intro: Make image-heavy PDFs easier to share. PDF42 offers compression controls so you can choose a practical balance between file size and image detail.
points: Choose 100, 150 or 220 dpi image presets.
Preview file sizes while keeping text and vector content sharp.
Save a separate file and compare the result with the original.
steps: Open your PDF and choose compression.
Choose an image preset and compare the size estimates.
Save the result, then check its size and legibility.
compress-pdf.note: Results depend on the source file and may show no size reduction. Compression reduces image quality and removes existing digital signatures.
compress-pdf.question: How much smaller will my PDF be?
compress-pdf.answer: There is no fixed reduction. Scanned and image-heavy PDFs often offer more room for compression than files that are already optimised.

labels-codes.title: Codes, marks and labels in millimetres
labels-codes.seoTitle: QR Code, Barcode and CE Mark Label Maker for Mac | OFF42
labels-codes.seoDescription: Create QR, Data Matrix, Code 128 and Aztec codes, add CE, UKCA, EAC, FCC and other product marks, and print label sheets from spreadsheet rows on your Mac. Free.
labels-codes.intro: Put a scannable code or a conformity mark into a PDF, document or spreadsheet, then print a full sheet of labels from your data. Sizes are set in millimetres.
points: Insert QR, Data Matrix, Code 128 and Aztec codes that stay editable after saving.
Add 97 product marks — conformity (CE, UKCA, EAC, FCC, UL, CCC), environmental (WEEE, RoHS), GHS hazard pictograms and IEC safety symbols — with their conditions of use.
Print label sheets from spreadsheet rows, document tables or a PDF region on 559 stock formats or your own grid.
steps: Select a cell, table, text or PDF region, then choose Insert › Symbol or Code or File › Create Labels.
Pick the code type or symbol, the width in millimetres, the label stock and the code column.
Check the preview, then save a PDF or print with your printer's calibration.
labels-codes.note: Marks are artwork: inserting one does not certify the product. Use conformity marks and trademarks only when your product is certified or you hold the licence; the app shows each mark's conditions. Check paper and printer tolerances with a test print. On macOS; the dialog is translated into English, Russian and Turkish, mark names into 11 languages.
labels-codes.question: Do codes stay editable after I save the file?
labels-codes.answer: Yes. PDF, DOCX, XLSX and ODS files keep the code's recipe, so Edit Symbol or Code reopens it; other apps see an ordinary image. A spreadsheet code captures the cell value when inserted and does not follow later edits.

sign-pdf.title: Make your mark on a PDF
sign-pdf.seoTitle: Sign PDF on Mac — Signatures, Stamps, Digital Signing | OFF42
sign-pdf.seoDescription: Add a handwritten-style signature or a stamp to a PDF, or sign it with a certificate. PDF42 keeps your marks in a reusable library. Free and open source.
sign-pdf.intro: Keep signatures and stamps close to your work. Add a visual signature, reuse a stamp or work with certificate-based digital signatures in PDF42.
points: Keep reusable signatures and stamps in the shared library.
Place and adjust a visual mark on the page.
Use certificate-based signing when your workflow requires it.
steps: Open the document and choose the signature tool.
Select a visual mark or a digital-signature workflow.
Save and check the result in your recipient's PDF software.
sign-pdf.note: A visual signature is not a certificate-backed digital signature. Certificate trust and timestamp interoperability depend on the certificate, service and receiving software.
sign-pdf.question: Are visual and digital signatures the same?
sign-pdf.answer: No. A visual signature is a mark on the page. A digital signature uses a certificate to help detect document changes and identify the signer.

image-editor.title: The finishing touch, without the fuss
image-editor.seoTitle: Free Image Editor for Mac — Crop, Resize, Annotate | OFF42
image-editor.seoDescription: Open JPEG, PNG, HEIC, WebP and TIFF, then crop, resize, rotate, adjust and annotate with IMG42. A free, open-source image editor that works offline.
image-editor.intro: Open a photo, crop a distraction, adjust the image or add a clear annotation. IMG42 keeps everyday image tasks close at hand.
points: View common image formats, including JPEG, PNG, HEIC and TIFF.
Crop, resize, rotate and adjust images.
Add markup and export to supported image formats.
steps: Open an image on your Mac.
Make your adjustments and review the pixels.
Export a copy in a format suited to its use.
image-editor.note: Reading and writing support varies by format and macOS codec availability. Some formats can be opened but cannot be saved in their original form.
image-editor.question: Can I resize an image before sharing it?
image-editor.answer: Yes. Resize the image and export a copy. Review the dimensions and choose a format that preserves the transparency or image quality you need.

download.title: Your next office starts here.
download.intro: Free for every platform. Pick yours, download, and start working.
download.macText: The source targets macOS 14 or later. A public DMG installer has not been released yet.
download.windowsText: Native Windows apps are implemented and available as source code. Check the documented features and limitations. A public Windows installer has not been released.
download.sourceTitle: Build it. Read it. Make it yours.
download.sourceText: Every line of OFF42 is MIT-licensed on GitHub. Build it yourself, read how it works or send an improvement.
download.releaseNote: The Mac preview is signed ad hoc. Apple notarization is unavailable for this build, and macOS may ask you to approve the first launch.
download.buildText: Until a signed installer is published, you can build the apps yourself in a few minutes. Run these commands in Terminal.
download.buildStep1: Install Apple's Xcode Command Line Tools.
download.buildStep2: Download the source code from GitHub.
download.buildStep3: Build all six apps, or build one app and copy it to Applications.
download.windowsPreviewText: All six apps in one ZIP. Extract it anywhere and start any app — nothing else to install.
download.installMac: Mac: if macOS says the app can’t be opened, open System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway. You only do this once per app.
download.installWindows: Windows: if SmartScreen says “Windows protected your PC”, click More info, then Run anyway.
download.webText: Nothing to install: a preview that opens, converts and creates files inside your browser tab. Documents cannot be exported to PDF and PDF pages are not displayed yet.
download.linuxText: Experimental x86_64 preview: the off42 command line converts documents, spreadsheets and presentations, exports PDF and makes labels, barcodes, marks, signatures and stamps. The six apps open in a simple window. Page views, rich editing, printing, scanning and OCR are not available on Linux yet.
download.linuxPreviewText: All six apps and the off42 command line in one archive. Extract it and run ./install.sh to add the apps to your menu.
download.installLinux: Linux: extract the archive and run ./off42 --help, or run ./install.sh to add the apps to your menu. The app windows need X11 or Wayland.
download.macPreviewText: All six apps in one disk image. Open it and drag the apps you want to Applications.

about.title: An office with nothing to hide.
about.intro: OFF42 brings together six native apps for macOS and Windows: PDFs, documents, spreadsheets, presentations, images and scans. Free and open source, with separate platform implementations and documented limitations.
about.licenseText: Use, study, modify and redistribute the software under the MIT license. The repository includes the license terms and source code.
about.contributeTitle: Better tools are a shared effort.
about.contributeText: Report a reproducible bug, suggest an improvement, help with translations or contribute code through GitHub.
about.honestText: The project is evolving. The repository documents tested builds, limitations and audit coverage. Source availability is separate from packaged, signed and notarised releases.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: OFF42 is built to work on your device. The apps do not collect, store or share personal data, and we never see your documents.

sections.title: Who we are
text: OFF42 is a free, open-source office suite published by its developer as an independent project. This policy covers the OFF42 apps for macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, iPad and iPhone, the web version at off42.cc/app and the website off42.cc.

sections.title: Data we collect
text: None. The apps have no accounts, advertising, analytics, tracking or crash reporting, and they do not send usage data to us or to anyone else. We do not sell or share personal data because we do not have any.

sections.title: Your documents
text: Your files are opened, edited, converted and saved on your device. They are not uploaded to us. Signatures, stamps, settings, recent files and recovery copies of unsaved work are kept only on your device, in the app's own storage, and you can delete them at any time by deleting the files or uninstalling the app.
The mobile apps open and save files only through the system's file picker or when you share a file to them, and they do not request network access.

sections.title: Features that use the internet
text: A few optional PDF42 features on the Mac contact a server, and only when you use them: a trusted timestamp is requested from the timestamp server you choose (DigiCert by default); validating or extending a digital signature downloads revocation data from the addresses written in the certificates; remote signing sends a document hash — never the document — to the signing service you configure. These services process your request under their own privacy policies.

sections.title: The web version
text: off42.cc/app runs in your browser. After the page and its engine have loaded, it makes no further network requests: the files you open stay in your browser tab and are never uploaded.

sections.title: The website
text: off42.cc has no cookies, advertising or analytics scripts. It is hosted by Cloudflare, which processes technical request data such as IP addresses to deliver the site and protect it from abuse. Downloads are served from GitHub. Both act under their own privacy policies.

sections.title: Children
text: OFF42 is suitable for all ages and collects no data from anyone, including children.

sections.title: Changes and contact
text: If this policy changes, the new version will be published on this page with a new effective date. Questions about privacy can be sent through the project's GitHub page.

sections.title: Ask a question or report a problem
text: Open an issue on GitHub and describe what you did, what you expected and what happened. Include your platform and app version, and attach a sample file only if it contains nothing private.

text: Feature guides, supported formats and known limitations for each platform are on GitHub.
